title: feat: INS-05 capability cache keys and provenance
body:
## Scope
Implement only INS-05: each shipped capability declares dependencies; its key binds explicit host version, plugin version, project policy and declared-input hashes. Reuse unchanged entries with original provenance; unavailable inputs degrade only their dependent capability. The optional schema-1 cache persists through the ordinary mutation pipeline only when the verb already publishes state: cache refresh does not turn a no-op/preview into accounting or publication. Status is read-only and doctor remains stateless. Descriptor resolution is not a new native-host observation.

## Changes
- Add strict closed-key cache/provenance schemas, adapter preparation and pipeline wiring.
- Add seven [INS-05] controls and a built scratch UAT journey for selective reuse, persisted provenance and repeated-open no-op preservation.
- Update canonical specifications, install/help and plugin text.

## Evidence
Exact head `211958bbcadf17fded7f34aec707feb0216c3e0c`: [PR run42409929093 attempt2](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42409929093/attempts/2) and [push run42409925194 attempt2](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42409925194/attempts/2) both completed successfully. All six surfaced PR platform checks pass. PR jobs: Ubuntu128527426887, macOS128527465352, Windows128527424809. Push jobs: Ubuntu128528704498, macOS128528703955, Windows128528702659.

Both POSIX platforms passed full CI (1,755/1,755 tests) and built scratch UAT on Node24 and Node22.12.0. Both UAT executions include the ten-entry INS-05 selective-cache/provenance and repeated-open no-op journey. Windows passed all bounded gates, including starter restore on both Node versions.

Original attempt1 Windows starter five-second timeouts remain preserved. Both unchanged-head failed-job retries passed without source or timeout changes. Read-only comparison demonstrated run variation, not an isolated cause; a pre-existing runtime defect remains unproven.

Local focused controls, typecheck, all lints, M0 structural coverage, 785 KB/900 KB build, complete payload and same-toolchain reproducibility pass. Staged and outgoing privacy scans found no likely leaks; scans prove no absence. Windows mutating workflows remain deliberately unsupported: the local persistence control verifies refusal, not POSIX persistence. Native host behavior remains unobserved.

Prior head53d6fa6 exposed seven no-op/accounting regressions. A portable regression reproduced the root cause before repair be8fbd3: absent verb state was promoted into publication by cache attachment. Absent state now stays absent; repaired-head full CI/UAT proves the correction.

## Dependencies and review
Includes approved D01 capacity-only commits cherry-picked from the coordinated lane; no schema-2 dependency or activation. Shared D01 tooling-portability correction070bb23 was cherry-picked unchanged as53d6fa6; 11 local portability controls pass, including exact921600-byte acceptance/921601-byte rejection. Implementation/schema commit:649d2338f101116e506f682927c9f1e6ede0f714.

Executable/effects changes retain the solo72-hour review window. Owner merges; no automatic merge. Predicted changelog integration conflict with capacity PR will be addressed only after prerequisite merge and owner-authorized branch update, preserving all feature entries.
